capabilities.title: Open-source vector design tool: frames, components, auto-layout, prototyping
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Penpot: self-hosted Figma alternative with SVG-native file format
capabilities.reason: Nexus is not a design tool. Penpot's core product is outside scope.

capabilities.title: SVG-native file format: design files are valid SVG, readable without proprietary software
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Penpot: all assets stored as plain SVG with custom extensions
capabilities.reason: Nexus uses SVG for assets; Penpot's SVG-native storage and open format approach is a reference for Nexus asset pipeline decisions.

capabilities.title: Design token export: colors, typography, spacing as structured JSON
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Penpot design tokens: CSS variables and JSON export
capabilities.reason: Nexus theming could adopt a design token export format; reference for the theme system (aegis-cosmos, citadel, etc.).

capabilities.title: ClojureScript + WebGL canvas renderer for high-performance design canvas
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Penpot frontend: ClojureScript with custom WebGL rendering pipeline
capabilities.reason: Nexus is a TypeScript/React app; ClojureScript rendering infrastructure is not applicable.
